connection.label: Stripe connection
connection.comingSoonTitle: Getting paid through Stripe is coming soon
connection.comingSoonBody: Until then, buyers pay you through your product's buy link, or by emailing you.
connection.connectBody: Payouts go straight to your bank. Setup happens securely on Stripe, we never see or store your bank details.
connection.requirementsDue: Stripe needs more information before payouts can continue.

connectModal.title: Connect with Stripe
connectModal.description: Get paid for what you sell. Setup happens on Stripe, not here.

sensitive.body: Bank details, identity checks and verification all happen on Stripe's secure pages. Square Share never sees or stores them.

bank.title: Payouts go straight to your bank
bank.body: Once connected, your balance is paid out automatically on a rolling schedule.

time.title: Takes about 5 minutes
time.body: You'll be redirected to Stripe to finish setup, then land right back here.
